# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers in Chance's Claim, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO LET[/bold], A-Block western dorms, close to the kitchens. Door bar fitted. References from a shift supervisor, please. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], quiet room within walking distance of the processor, for a filtration tech on night rotation. Will pay on time. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Colony housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]HEAVY VEHICLE OPERATOR[/bold] sought for the ore run to the landing pads. Must drive in a crosswind and say no to unscheduled stops. - [bold]HYDROPONICS HANDS[/bold] wanted for the B-Block bays. Warm, dry, and the only place in town that smells green. - [bold]NIGHT WATCH[/bold] wanted for a C-Block storefront. No weapon supplied. The owner is honest about why.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]RAIN CAPES AND WIND GOGGLES[/bold], patched and resealed. Cheaper than a doctor's visit after a gale. - [bold]DOOR LOCKS[/bold], heavy, two keys each. Fitted free for widows and pensioners.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: brown work coat with a mining surveyor's badge, left at the bar. No questions asked about the bar tab.
## Notices - To whoever moved the crates out of the container yard last week: the serial numbers are written down, and not only by Company Security.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
